programs.title: Ainsley's Taste Of The Bahamas
programs.desc: Ainsley starts the day with Bahamian-style coffee and a morning fish dish at a beachside shack, then takes in some undersea art at the Clifton Heritage Park before plating up a plantain-and-sweet-potato rosti with crab salad for a full Bahamian breakfast.

programs.title: Gary Barlow's Food & Wine: Australia
programs.desc: Travel series. Gary meets old friend Andi Peters in South Australia to try barrel-making and meet the Willy Wonka of Wine.

programs.title: Bring A Plate
programs.desc: The guests are thrilled to try Rachel's South Korean dish, Bossam. Not everyone is able to eat the pork but they can all enjoy and learn about kimchic, the hero of all Korean food.

programs.title: Come Dine With Me The Professionals
programs.desc: Today's Come Dine With Me Professionals heads to Swansea and first up are childhood mates Ash and Suj from Adelinas who are pitting their modern Indian cooking against their fellow pros.

programs.title: Destination Flavour
programs.desc: Renee meets winemaker turned sheep farmer David Hohnen, Adam learns about the new craze for hot and cold smoking in Melbourne, while Lily catches up with leading providore Simon Johnson.

programs.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programs.desc: Noodles for one, anyone? Adam and his guests, Lilly Wright from Flying Chillies in Ballarat and comedian Sasha Perera share their solo noodle go-tos.
